documents.title: Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release
Compliances-Certificate under Reg. 74 (5) of SEBI (DP) Regulations, 2018
Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release

analysis.summary: Hero MotoCorp reported its highest-ever annual revenue, EBITDA, and PAT for financial year 2026, driven by strong performance across scooters, EVs, and global business segments. Management highlighted continued investments in capacity expansion, brand building, R&D, and new product launches for FY27 while navigating near-term commodity headwinds. The company remains committed to its medium-term EBITDA margin guidance of 14% to 16% and anticipates high single-digit volume growth for the industry. Hero MotoCorp reported a strong financial performance for FY 2025-26, achieving record annual revenue of ₹ 46,830 crore and Profit After Tax of ₹ 5,268 crore, while sustaining its global leadership as the world's largest two-wheeler manufacturer for 25 consecutive years. The company expanded its global footprint across 52 countries, scaled its premium and electric mobility portfolios with new product introductions such as the VIDA VX2 EVOOTER, and improved EBITDA margins to 14.7%.

guidance.claim: The management anticipates high single-digit volume growth for the two-wheeler industry during the current fiscal year.
guidance.quote: We are confident in the growth prospects of the 2-wheeler industry and anticipate high single-digit growth during the current fiscal year.

guidance.claim: Management expects to grow ahead of the industry supported by resilient demand and upcoming product launches.
guidance.quote: With resilient demand and upcoming product launches, we expect to grow ahead of the industry.

demand_outlook.claim: The two-wheeler sector has started the year on a positive note, continuing the momentum from the second half of FY26.
demand_outlook.quote: On the demand side, 2-wheeler sector has started the year on a positive note, continuing the momentum that we saw in the second half of FY '26.

demand_outlook.claim: Management notes that scooters are expected to grow a couple of points more than motorcycles.
demand_outlook.quote: Having said that, we do expect scooters to grow a couple of points more than motorcycles.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that the Indian two-wheeler industry continued to demonstrate strong growth momentum, marking the fourth consecutive year of expansion.
demand_outlook.quote: The Indian two-wheeler industry continues to demonstrate strong growth momentum, with FY 2025-26 marking the fourth consecutive year of expansion.

demand_outlook.claim: Post festive demand continues to stay strong with January 2026 retail growing at 21% year-on-year.
demand_outlook.quote: Post festive demand continues to stay strong with January '26 retail growing at 21% year-on-year.

demand_outlook.claim: Management expects the positive demand trend to continue in the coming months.
demand_outlook.quote: We expect this positive demand trend to continue in the coming months.

capex_expansion.claim: The company has committed over 1,500 crores of capex in FY27 to expand capacity in growth segments like scooters.
capex_expansion.quote: We are investing in capacity expansion, and we have committed over ₹1,500 crores of capex in FY '27.

capex_expansion.claim: Hero MotoCorp committed over 700 crores of investment to build a global parts center in the south of India.
capex_expansion.quote: So we've committed over ₹700 crores of investment in building out a global parts center in South of India.

margins_costs.claim: Ice business EBITDA margin expanded by 90 basis points to 17% in financial year 2026.
margins_costs.quote: The ICE business EBITDA margin in financial year '26 expanded by 90 basis points to 17%, driven by pricing, LEAP savings and operating leverage.

margins_costs.claim: Management remains committed to the medium-term margin guidance of 14% to 16%.
margins_costs.quote: We remain committed to our medium-term margin guidance of 14% to 16%.

margins_costs.claim: ICE business EBITDA margin expanded by 100 bps year-on-year to 17% driven by pricing, LEAP savings and operating leverage.
margins_costs.quote: ICE business EBITDA margin expanded by 100 bps year-on-year to 17%, driven by pricing, LEAP savings and operating leverage.

margins_costs.claim: The company took cognizance of the new labour code and made a provision of INR 119 crores reported as an exceptional item.
margins_costs.quote: During the quarter, the company has taken cognizance of the new labour code and has made provision of INR119 crores, which is reported as an exceptional item.

orders_capacity.claim: Dealer inventory stands at around 5 weeks.
orders_capacity.quote: Yes. So in terms of the dealer inventory, it's around 5 weeks, I'll say.

orders_capacity.claim: The company operates six manufacturing facilities in India along with dedicated plants in Colombia and Bangladesh, supporting an annual production capacity of approximately 8.63 million units.
orders_capacity.quote: With six state-of-the-art facilities in India and dedicated plants in Colombia and Bangladesh, we have a strong manufacturing presence supporting an impressive annual production capacity of approximately 8.63* million units.

capital_allocation.claim: The Board declared a final dividend of 75 rupees per share, taking total FY26 dividends to 185 rupees.
capital_allocation.quote: I'm happy to inform that the Board has declared final dividend of ₹75 per share, taking the total dividend in financial year '26 to ₹185, our highest ever dividend.

capital_allocation.claim: Cash flow from operations for the full year stood at 9,395 crores, driven by working capital improvements.
capital_allocation.quote: Our focus on cash management resulted in strong cash flow from operations, which stood at ₹9,395 crores for the full year '26, an increase of 80% year-on-year, driven by working capital improvements.

capital_allocation.claim: Operating cash generated in 9 months stands at INR 7,045 crores.
capital_allocation.quote: Operating cash generated in 9 months stands at INR7,045 crores.

risks_headwinds.claim: The broader economy is navigating short-term uncertainties due to developments in West Asia.
risks_headwinds.quote: As FY '27 begins, the broader economy is navigating certain short-term uncertainties due to the developments in West Asia.

risks_headwinds.claim: The industry is currently facing commodity headwinds that began in March.
risks_headwinds.quote: While operating momentum remains strong, the industry is currently facing commodity headwinds that began in March.

management_commitments.claim: The company has committed over 1,500 crores of capex in FY27.
management_commitments.quote: We are investing in capacity expansion, and we have committed over ₹1,500 crores of capex in FY '27.

management_commitments.claim: Management remains committed to its medium-term margin guidance of 14% to 16%.
management_commitments.quote: We remain committed to our medium-term margin guidance of 14% to 16%.

management_commitments.claim: The company plans to focus on executing and accelerating growth ambitions over the next few years.
management_commitments.quote: As I look forward to the next few years of our journey, we will focus on executing and accelerating our growth ambitions.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
